items.title: Stock Radar: Precision Wires stock hits fresh record high in April; breaks out from 1-month consolidation
items.description: Precision Wires India stock has achieved a new record high after breaking out of a consolidation phase. Experts anticipate further upward movement, setting a target of Rs 410 for short-term traders. The stock has shown significant gains recently, trading above key moving averages. Technical indicators suggest a bullish trend, with a potential for continued growth.

items.title: RBI plans to remain nimble to prevent persistent supply shock amid West Asia crisis
items.description: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra addressed global challenges at Princeton University, stressing upon agile monetary policy to counter supply shocks from West Asia. The focus is on preventing inflation from becoming persistent. Prudent fiscal management and domestic production also play key roles, he said.

items.title: RBI allows NDF contracts to clients, rebooking of related party trades
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India has made a pivotal move by retracting its earlier April 1 directive, which had restricted banks from offering non-deliverable forward contracts and barred the rebooking of cancelled foreign exchange derivative contracts. This reversal allows banks to enjoy increased operational flexibility, fostering a more fluid trading environment.

items.title: Vedanta shares in focus after company announces record date for demerger. Check timeline, other details
items.description: Vedanta will be in focus after announcing May 1 as the record date for its long-awaited demerger. Shareholders will receive shares in multiple newly listed entities, including aluminium, power and oil & gas businesses. The restructuring aims to unlock value by splitting operations into focused, sector-specific companies under a revised structure.

items.title: Signatureglobal among 3 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On April 20, three stocks from the Nifty 500 segment were identified in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. “RSI trending up” indicates that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) is rising, suggesting strengthening price momentum in the stock. This may signal potential upward movement and can be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Stock split alert! L&T-backed firm to divide shares in 1:10 ratio. Here’s everything you need to know
items.description: E2E Networks will be in focus after its board approved a 1:10 stock split, aimed at improving liquidity and retail participation. The company continues expanding its AI and cloud capabilities through Nvidia partnerships, while strong institutional backing, including Larsen & Toubro’s stake, underscores investor confidence in its growth strategy.

items.title: Yes Bank among 7 stocks closing below VWAP
items.description: On April 20, the closing prices of seven stocks from the Nifty 500 segment fell more than 1.5% below their VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price). A move below the VWAP suggests a potential bearish trend, according to StockEdge technical scan data.When the closing price falls below the VWAP, it indicates that the stock ended the session lower than the average price at which it traded throughout the day, weighted by volume. This reflects increased selling pressure and weaker intraday sentiment.

items.title: Indian Energy Exchange among 6 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of April 20, there was a notable surge in futures open interest for six stocks in the NSE F&O pack, contributing to a total increase of over 7% compared to the previous trade. A sharp rise in futures open interest indicates growth in active, unexpired futures contracts, reflecting more participants initiating new positions or expanding existing ones.

items.title: Stocks to buy in 2026 for long term: HDFC Bank, M&M among 5 stocks that could give 10-30% return
items.description: Brokerages remain constructive on select large-cap names across banking, financial services, and automobiles, highlighting a mix of steady earnings visibility and structural growth opportunities.We have collated a list of recommendations from top brokerage firms from ETNow and other sources:

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 8 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the NSE list of stocks with a market cap over Rs 10,000 crore, eight stocks' close prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on April 20, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. The 200-day daily moving average (DMA) is used as a key indicator by traders for determining the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily time frame, it is generally considered to be an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: GIFT Nifty up 85 points; here's the trading setup for today's session
items.description: Benchmark indices ended flat as India VIX surged 10%, signaling near-term volatility. Markets are expected to consolidate, influenced by geopolitical developments. Immediate support for the index is seen at 56,200-56,300, with resistance at 57,200.

items.title: Stocks in news: HCL Tech, Vedanta, Jio Financial, IndusInd Bank, Suzlon Energy
items.description: Markets are cautious as a ceasefire nears expiry. Oil prices rose, and the rupee weakened, sparking inflation worries. Investors are watching the Q4 earnings season. Stocks like HCL Tech, Vedanta, and Jio Financial are in focus. Vedanta's demerger is set for May 1, 2026. HCL Tech reports Tuesday. Jio Financial expands its lending. TVS Motor enters Zambia.

items.title: These large-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of up to 25%
items.description: If you are putting fresh money into the market, it might be a good idea to stay with companies that don't have much to do with global supply chains and where the underlying product or service fulfills a “need” of people, or is “essential” in some way. The reason: With the ongoing Gulf war, we are not talking much these days about the impact of tariffs. But their impact will soon show up – both in terms of bottom lines as also the narrative on the street.

items.title: ICICI up, HDFC down after Q4 show; analysts positive on both
items.description: ICICI Bank shares saw a rise on Monday, while HDFC Bank shares experienced a fall. This happened even as both banks reported fourth-quarter earnings that met expectations. Analysts remain positive on both lenders. Investor positioning appears to be driving this divergence in stock performance. Target prices show potential upside for both banks.

items.title: Jio Financial Services to scale lending, holds off unsecured credit
items.description: Jio Financial Services is expanding its lending book with property and asset-backed corporate loans. The company prioritizes balance sheet strength before venturing into unsecured credit. Its loan book currently focuses on these secured segments. Jio Financial Services aims to be a full-service financial provider, with its payments bank and payment aggregator businesses also showing growth.

items.title: SFIO widens probe into IndusInd Bank; summons audit firms over ₹2,000 crore derivatives irregularities
items.description: The Serious Fraud Investigation Office is investigating IndusInd Bank's derivatives portfolio. Major audit firms associated with the bank over the last decade have been summoned. This probe follows questioning of former bank officials. The irregularities are estimated to have caused losses of around ₹2,000 crore. The investigation aims to uncover corporate governance issues and accounting discrepancies.

items.title: Oberoi Realty shares rise 3% after sharp surge in Q4FY26  bookings
items.description: Oberoi Realty shares witnessed an uptick on Tuesday after the developer reported a sharp jump in Q4FY26 bookings, which doubled sequentially to Rs 1,673 crore. Volumes and carpet area booked surged.

items.title: Bank of Maharashtra shares jump 13% in three sessions! Time to buy after Q4 results?
items.description: Shares of Bank of Maharashtra surged up to 6% after reporting a strong Q4 FY26, with net profit rising 35% YoY to Rs 2,014 crore. Growth was driven by an 18.8% jump in net interest income and a 13% increase in overall revenues, reflecting robust operational performance.

items.title: Brokerages initiate coverage on Suzlon, Groww, 5 other stocks with up to 28% upside. Do you own any?
items.description: A host of domestic and global brokerages have initiated coverage on select Indian stocks across sectors such as broking, renewable energy and consumer durables. Analysts are bullish on major names such as Groww, Suzlon and forecast strong upside from current market levels. Here is a list of 7 stocks on which brokerages initiated coverage.

items.title: Angel One shares rise 15% in just one week! Should investors buy after Q4 results?
items.description: Angel One shares saw a slight uptick, recovering from a prior dip and showing a significant rally over the past week. The company reported strong year-on-year growth in net profit and gross revenue, driven by increased client participation and digital platform usage.

items.title: Monolithisch's promoter Prabhat Tekriwal mints 3,390% returns as SME stock delivers 243% over IPO price
items.description: Monolithisch India promoter Prabhat Tekriwal has seen his pre-IPO stake surge by 3,390% to Rs 100 crore. The SME company, a remixed high-quality ramming mass manufacturer, listed on NSE Emerge with a significant premium. Experts advise caution due to high valuations and a broader corrective phase, suggesting a wait-and-watch approach.

items.title: Suzlon Energy shares gain 15% one week: Further rally or sharp correction ahead?
items.description: India faces a power crunch this summer. Heatwaves are increasing demand, while gas and hydro power generation is falling. This situation highlights the importance of wind energy. Suzlon Energy shares are showing strong momentum. Analysts suggest a cautious approach for fresh investments. The company has also signed a renewable energy partnership with a Korean firm.

items.title: Tata Motors PV vs Maruti Suzuki: Automaker stocks race up to 22% in April so far, should you buy?
items.description: Tata Motors and Maruti Suzuki shares have rebounded in April after a March decline. Analysts suggest Maruti Suzuki suits conservative investors seeking stability, while Tata Motors offers higher growth potential for medium-term horizons, driven by its EV push and product pipeline.

items.title: Nelco Shares jump 12% as company swings to profit in Q4
items.description: Nelco shares rose sharply on Tuesday after the company swung to a Q4 net profit of Rs 1.09 crore from a loss last year. Revenue rose 17%, boosting sentiment despite full-year profit pressure. FPIs and institutional investors also increased their stakes during the March quarter.

items.title: Anthem BioSciences shares jump 4% as Citi initiates with Buy rating. Check target, upside potential
items.description: Shares of Anthem BioSciences rose after Citi initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a target price of ₹870, implying over 20% upside. Analysts cited strong growth prospects, a robust portfolio of commercial molecules, sticky client relationships, and scalable manufacturing capabilities supporting long-term revenue visibility.

items.title: Groww shares jump over 3% after Q4 net profit soars 122%. What is Jefferies saying?
items.description: Billionbrains Garage Ventures shares jumped 3.6% after reporting a 122% YoY surge in Q4 net profit to Rs 686 crore, driven by strong revenue growth and operating leverage. Brokerages remain divided, with Jefferies maintaining a Buy rating and raising its target price, citing a strong recovery in trading activity and profitability.

items.title: Is the Indian middle class dream over? Saurabh Mukherjea on the 3 forces crushing your future
items.description: India's middle class is in deep trouble. Education no longer guarantees prosperity. Jobs are disappearing, especially in IT. Wages are not keeping pace with rising costs. Household debt is soaring, often for consumption. AI is further threatening jobs. This consumption engine slowdown impacts the economy. The middle class has limited political voice.

items.title: Clock ticking on Tuesday deadline: How will markets react if Iran ceasefire breaks or holds?
items.description: Indian markets brace for a crucial Tuesday deadline as a ceasefire between Iran, the US, and Israel nears expiration. The direction of crude oil prices, influenced by potential de-escalation or renewed hostilities, will likely dictate the trajectory of equities, currencies, and bond yields. Investors are closely monitoring oil's reaction to geopolitical developments.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: HDFC Securities maintains buy on Mastek; Elara Capital recommends accumulate rating on IEX
items.description: Brokerages show selective optimism for midcap IT, financials, and capital market stocks. HDFC Securities is positive on Mastek and Bank of Maharashtra, citing strong pipelines and asset quality. Elara Capital is cautious on Indian Energy Exchange due to regulatory risks. Analysts are adopting a stock-specific approach, focusing on earnings visibility and structural strengths amidst evolving market dynamics.

items.title: El Niño and geopolitical tensions cloud India’s rural economy: A somber 2026 outlook
items.description: India’s rural economy faces pressure in 2026 from a likely El Niño-driven weak monsoon and rising input costs due to US-Iran tensions. Lower farm output, weak incomes, and elevated inflation may hit consumption, while higher fertiliser subsidies could strain fiscal balances, keeping the overall outlook cautious.

items.title: PNB Housing Finance soars 10% post Q4 results: Why Morgan Stanley, other brokerages remain bullish
items.description: In a thrilling market reaction, PNB Housing Finance saw its stock surge by 10 percent in response to the robust Q4 FY26 financial results. The company announced a stunning 19 percent increase in net profit compared to last year, prompting brokerages like Morgan Stanley and JM Financial to reaffirm their buy recommendations.

items.title: Sensex rises over 700 points, Nifty tops 24,550 as investors eye Iran-US peace talks. What lies ahead?
items.description: Indian stock markets traded higher on Tuesday. The Sensex and Nifty saw gains as investors anticipated peace talks between Iran and the US. Volatility in the markets decreased. Adani Ports, ICICI Bank, and L&T were among the top gainers. Realty stocks also performed well. IT stocks experienced minor declines.

items.title: Tata Steel shares jump 12% so far in April. Here’s why Nomura stays bullish on India’s steel sector
items.description: Tata Steel shares are nearing record highs, up 12% in April, as Nomura maintains a bullish outlook on India's resilient steel sector. The brokerage believes global headwinds, including Chinese competition and Middle East conflict impacts, will have limited effect on major players' earnings potential.

items.title: Patanjali Foods declares Rs 1.75/share interim dividend, sets April 25 as record date
items.description: Patanjali Foods has announced a second interim dividend of Rs 1.75 per share for FY26, amounting to 87.5% of its face value. Shareholders on record as of April 25, 2026, will receive this payout by May 20, 2026. This follows an earlier interim dividend of the same amount declared for the fiscal year.

items.title: Vedanta Demerger: Check record date, demerger ratio, other key things to know
items.description: Mining major Vedanta announced that the record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders for its much-awaited demerger has been set on May 1, and approved the demerger ratio for each of the newly carved-out businesses.

items.title: FIIs pull out another $2 billion from bank stocks. Are financials most hated now?
items.description: Brokerages remain constructive on banks despite near-term headwinds. Prabhudas Lilladher flags NIM pressure, slowing retail credit and macro risks, though credit growth has rebounded. Domestic funds see attractive valuations after FII selling, favouring large private lenders. BNP Paribas finds the risk-reward favourable, while Tata MF expects FY27 earnings upgrades. However, persistent FII outflows may continue to weigh on bank stocks.

items.title: Adani Power shares zoom nearly 40% in just 13 sessions. Should you book profits now?
items.description: Adani Power Limited shares have surged nearly 40% in 13 sessions, driven by strong momentum and rising power demand outlook. Analysts suggest holding positions amid bullish trends, while cautioning that overbought signals could trigger near-term consolidation, making dips potential buying opportunities rather than immediate profit-booking triggers.

items.title: HDFC, Yes Bank, SBI, AU Small Finance Bank shares jump up to 4%. Key Nifty Bank levels to watch out for
items.description: Indian bank stocks experienced a significant jump on Tuesday. AU Small Finance Bank, HDFC Bank, SBI, and Yes Bank saw notable increases. The Nifty Bank index climbed over 1%, marking it as a top sectoral performer. This rally was fueled by strong quarterly results from major banks like HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank.
